title: ProjectSync
tagline: An autonomous Taskmaster AI Agent that turns shipped GitHub repositories into career-ready assets with one click.
highlights: Engineered a 7-Node Directed Acyclic Graph agent workflow using Google ADK 2.0 to coordinate plain Python nodes and AI agent nodes.
Implemented a dual-layer memory architecture with Semantic Style Rules and an Episodic Transaction Ledger to maintain developer voice.
Built human-in-the-loop approval processes with dual-commit capabilities and multi-platform social draft management.
